input.content: Retry recovery that skips re-applying an idempotent side effect drops edited retry values (P1). Pattern: after a later step (e.g. a receipt write) fails, the code marks the record "applied" and on retry skips apply, or applies values stored on the first attempt instead of the current submission. When the contract says a retry may carry edited values and success means the latest values are active, and the provider is idempotent, every unfinished attempt must persist and re-apply the current values before completing. Tests that only retry with identical values cannot catch this. Add a test that fails the receipt, retries the same ID with different values, and asserts the new values are active.
